GBW=gm1/(2*pi*Cc)≈8 MHz with Cc=3 pF and gm1=150 uS. gm7≈0.9 mS puts p2 near 29 MHz, and Rz>1/gm7 adds a LHP zero, so PM is about 70 deg. The class-A output swings to about 0.2 V from each rail. Supply current is about 180 uA (≈330 uW): tail 20, folding sources 40, output stage 100, bias 30."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15, 10, 20),      # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),   # input pair L
    "Itail": (20e-6, 10e-6, 40e-6),
    "Ic":    (10e-6, 4e-6, 20e-6),   # cascode branch current
    "I7":    (100e-6, 60e-6, 140e-6),# output stage current
    "gmid7": (9, 6, 13),
    "L7":    (0.8, 0.3, 1.5),
    "Cc":    (3e-12, 1.5e-12, 5e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.5, 1.0, 3.0),   # Rz = rz_k/gm7
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),   # L of load/mirror devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8; vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    Lb = p["Lb"]; I1 = p["Itail"] / 2; Ic = p["Ic"]; Itop = I1 + Ic
    I7 = p["I7"]; Ib = iref
    gmid_n = 10.0; gmid_p = 8.0

    # ---- bias reference ----
    mnref = lut.size("n", gmid_n, Lb, iref, vds=0.65)
    vtail = 0.28
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, Lb, p["Itail"], vds=vtail)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, Lb, I7, vds=0.9)
    mnb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, Lb, Ib, vds=0.9)          # sink for vbp diode
    mpd = lut.size("p", gmid_p, Lb, Ib, vds=1.0)          # vbp diode
    vds3 = 0.30
    m3 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, Lb, Itop, vds=vds3)        # top current sources
    mpb = lut.size("p", gmid_p, Lb, Ib, vds=0.9)          # sources for vbpc / vbn branches

    # ---- input pair ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.0, vsb=vtail)
    # ---- PMOS cascodes ----
    m4 = lut.size("p", 12, 0.5, Ic, vds=0.6, vsb=vds3)
    vbpc = vdd - vds3 - m4.vgs
    # ---- NMOS bottom mirror + cascodes ----
    vds7b = 0.25
    m7b = lut.size("n", 8, Lb, Ic, vds=vds7b)
    m6 = lut.size("n", 12, 0.5, Ic, vds=0.4, vsb=vds7b)
    vbn = vds7b + m6.vgs
    # ---- second stage ----
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rbpc = max(vbpc, 0.05) / Ib
    Rbn = vbn / Ib
    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m7.gm
    Cc = p["Cc"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MNREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnref)
    n.dev("MNB", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MPD", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("MPB1", "vbpc", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.R("RBPC", "vbpc", "vss", Rbpc)
    n.dev("MPB2", "vbn", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.R("RBN", "vbn", "vss", Rbn)
    # first stage (vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "fa", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "fb", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3A", "fa", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M3B", "fb", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4A", "xa", "vbpc", "fa", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M4B", "out1", "vbpc", "fb", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M6A", "xa", "vbn", "sa", "vss", m6)
    n.dev("M6B", "out1", "vbn", "sb", "vss", m6)
    n.dev("M7A", "sa", "xa", "vss", "vss", m7b)
    n.dev("M7B", "sb", "xa", "vss", "vss", m7b)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # compensation
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    Rup = ((m4.gm + m4.gmbs) / m4.gds) / (m3.gds + m1.gds)
    Rdn = ((m6.gm + m6.gmbs) / m6.gds) / m7b.gds
    Rout1 = Rup * Rdn / (Rup + Rdn)
    A1 = gm1 * Rout1
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m6.cdd + 20e-15
    Co = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * (Co + Cc) + Co * Cc) / (2 * PI)
    zinv = Cc * (Rz - 1 / m7.gm)
    zf = 1 / (2 * PI * zinv) if zinv > 0 else 1e12
    pm_ = lambda f: math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / f))
    pmir = 2 * m7b.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m7b.cgg + m6.cdd))
    pfold = m4.gm / (2 * PI * (m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m4.cgg))
    pmc = (m6.gm) / (2 * PI * (m6.cgg + m7b.cdd))
    pm = 90 - pm_(p2) + pm_(zf) - 0.5 * pm_(pmir) - pm_(pfold) - pm_(pmc)
    itot = iref + Ib * 3 + 2 * Itop + I7
    power = vdd * itot
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing}
